confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear, premeditated pattern of an insider threat. The user (user_08) transitioned from reading files within their department to systematically accessing and downloading sensitive files from multiple other departments (Finance, Marketing, HR, Sales, Engineering, and Logs) over a period of seven days.

attack_chain.description: User_08 logs in from their normal IP.
User_08 begins reconnaissance by reading files in the Finance department, which is outside their normal directory.
User_08 expands reconnaissance to the Marketing department.
User_08 continues reconnaissance in the Finance department.
User_08 expands reconnaissance to Sales and Engineering departments.
User_08 transitions from reading to active data exfiltration by downloading files from Legal and Sales.
User_08 performs bulk data exfiltration across HR, Marketing, and Logs departments.

gaps: No evidence of external IP usage or session hijacking (IP remained constant), suggesting this is a pure insider threat.
Lack of information regarding whether user_08 had any legitimate reason or ticket for cross-departmental access.
narrative: User_08, a member of the legal department, engaged in a multi-day insider threat campaign. The user followed a pattern of reconnaissance by reading files across various departments (Finance, Engineering, Sales, Marketing) before escalating to the systematic downloading of sensitive data from HR, Marketing, and Logs.
